=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:283-295 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The retired-file cleanup checks only whether the final path component is a symlink, so a symlinked parent directory can redirect hashing and `rm` to a file outside the intended retired path.
  WHY: A matching file at the symlink target can be deleted despite the protection for consumer-owned files; z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this NIT while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1517 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The unquoted-expansion check returns `ask` before the guard can allow vetted literal-ID read loops, causing 11 tests to fail.
  WHY: The CI check fails; google_gemini-3_8-flash rated this BLOCKER while openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR.
- .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md; .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md; .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json; scripts/ai_labels.py:453-459 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Both hand-off commands try to add `ai:engine-claude`, but the label is absent from the contract used by `sync-labels` and the commands do not create it first.
  WHY: On a consumer repository without a manually created label, the label operation can fail or leave the issue unlabeled, preventing the subsequent `/reclarify` hand-off.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:32-34 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `target_ref` input description refers to the retired `/implement-plan-claude` flow and omits the trusted same-repository PR requirement enforced by authorization.
  WHY: Callers following the description can dispatch a target that authorization rejects; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this NIT while minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:51 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `force_claude_branch_review` input description says PR-backed `claude/**` branches run Claude-fixer mode, which this PR retired.
  WHY: The GitHub UI description misleads operators about the review path; behavior is unaffected.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1983 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The comment above the dead `claude-fixer-auto-merge` job incorrectly says actionlint rejects a constant `if: false`.
  WHY: The job is intentionally retained for compatibility and never runs, but the comment misleads maintainers about actionlint.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Consumer cleanup on the next `@stable` sync" includes deleting the six retired labels.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` or `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt` omits `ai-sync-labels.yml` and `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` does not invoke `scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels`; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro says this is by design because core-profile consumers would not have had the labels, while the other reviewers say core-profile consumers have no path to delete them.
- requirement: "11 in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py fail the same way on a clean origin/main (49c2f38a): #6127 changed the hook and its tests so they disagree. The same failures make tests-hooks-and-orchestrator red on #6174."
  expected_change_site: N/A — this is a pre-existing failure on `main`, not a deliverable of this PR.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Neither `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` nor `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` appears in `pr_changed_files.txt`; the failures are attributed to `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1517`, before the vetted literal-ID read loop approval at line 1528, and are described as out of scope for Phase 2.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:283-284 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The symlink guard checks only the final path component; a symlinked parent directory lets cleanup follow the parent and delete a file at the symlink destination.
  WHY: A retired file matching a retired hash can be deleted at the target, bypassing protection for consumer-modified content.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:51 | severity=NIT | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The `force_claude_branch_review` input description says PR-backed `claude/**` branches run Claude-fixer mode, which this PR retired.
  WHY: The description misleads operators in the GitHub UI; input behavior is unchanged.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1983 | severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `claude-fixer-auto-merge` dead-job comment incorrectly says actionlint rejects a constant `if: false`.
  WHY: The job is intentionally retained for compatibility and never runs, but the comment misleads maintainers about the reason.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:33 | severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `target_ref` input description refers to `/implement-plan-claude`, which no longer dispatches validation.
  WHY: A caller following the description may dispatch a target rejected by the authorization step.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Consumer cleanup on the next @stable sync" includes deleting the six retired labels, per the PR description's "Consumer cleanup on the next @stable sync" section and the plan's step 5.
  Expected change site: The retired labels are deleted by the label-sync workflow (`sync_ai_labels.yml` via `scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels`) triggered by the `@stable` repository_dispatch.
  Evidence of absence: `update_workflows.yml` has no `ai_labels.py sync-labels` invocation, but this is by design — label sync runs through a separate workflow dispatch path (`sync_ai_labels.yml` → `ai_labels.py sync-labels`). The `retired_labels` array added to `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json` is the contract change that triggers deletion; consumers on standard/full profiles will delete the retired labels on their next `@stable` sync via the existing dispatch mechanism. Core profile consumers do not have label sync wired, but they also would not have had the retired labels in the first place (the labels are only created by paths core profile does not include).
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:631 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The unquoted-expansion check at line 1513 executes before loop vetting at line 1528, so vetted literal-ID read loops containing `$r` or `${r}` are rejected with `ask`.
  WHY: CI fails with 11 assertion errors in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`, causing the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job and aggregate lint check to fail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:51 | severity=NIT | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The `force_claude_branch_review` input description says PR-backed `claude/**` branches run Claude-fixer mode, which this PR retired.
  WHY: The description misleads operators dispatching the workflow through GitHub Actions.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:283-295 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The symlink check protects only the final path component, leaving a symlinked parent directory unprotected.
  WHY: `rm` follows the parent symlink and can delete a file at the symlink destination instead of protecting consumer-owned content.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:32-34 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `target_ref` input description refers to the retired `/implement-plan-claude` flow and omits the trusted same-repository PR requirement.
  WHY: A caller following the description may dispatch a target that authorization refuses, without a description of the actual requirement.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:51 | severity=NIT | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The `force_claude_branch_review` input description still says PR-backed `claude/` branches run Claude-fixer mode, which this PR retired.
  WHY: An operator reading the GitHub UI before a manual dispatch is misled; runtime behavior is unaffected.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1980-1990 | severity=NIT | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The dead job's `if` condition is never true, and its comment incorrectly claims actionlint rejects a constant `if: false`.
  WHY: The dead code is intentional, but the comment misleads maintainers about actionlint.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:248-311 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The retired-file cleanup is a new implicit deletion surface without per-file confirmation or an operator-visible preview, and its symlink guard does not protect against symlinked parent directories.
  WHY: If the guard is bypassed through a symlinked parent, cleanup can delete a consumer-owned file at the symlink destination without attributing the deletion to the recognized path.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Consumer cleanup on the next `@stable` sync" includes deleting the six retired labels via `scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels`.
  Expected change site: either `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt` (add `ai-sync-labels.yml`), or `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` (call `scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels` directly in the sync).
  Evidence of absence: The core profile in `workflow-templates/profiles/core.txt` does not list `ai-sync-labels.yml`; `ai-sync-labels.yml` is in `standard.txt` and `full.txt` only. `update_workflows.yml` does not invoke `scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels`. A consumer on the `core` profile therefore has no path through which the six retired labels (`ai:claude-blocked`, `ai:claude-handoff-failed`, `ai:claude-issue-queue-stale`, `ai:permission-prompt`, `ai:codex`, `ai:claude` per the new `retired_labels` array) are removed on the next sync, so the PR's stated consumer-cleanup guarantee does not reach that profile.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:283–295 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup rejects a symlink only when the retired file itself is a symlink; it does not reject a symlink in a parent directory.
  WHY: With a symlinked parent such as `.claude/commands`, hashing and `rm` can follow the link to a matching file at the target, bypassing protection for consumer-owned files.
- .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md; .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md; .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json; scripts/ai_labels.py:453-459 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Both hand-off commands try to add `ai:engine-claude`, but the label is absent from the contract used by `sync-labels` and the commands do not create it first.
  WHY: On a consumer repository without a manually created label, the label operation can fail or leave the issue unlabeled, preventing the subsequent `/reclarify` hand-off.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:32-34; authorization at lines 187-224 | severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `target_ref` description says `/implement-plan-claude` sets it and suggests selecting a branch instead of the integration or default branch.
